flags.why: The example defines the title instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Thiền vu sai sứ giả đến gặp hoàng đế. = The chanyu sent an envoy to meet the emperor.

flags.why: “Đẳng” already means “đằng ấy”, so “đẳng kia” incorrectly treats it as interchangeable with “đằng” ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-%C4%91%E1%BA%B3ng)).
flags.fix: Quán cà phê ở đẳng. = The coffee shop is over there.

flags.why: “Nũng” means to seek affection or pampering, not to be overripe or spoiled ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-n%C5%A9ng)).
